text.heroLede: Printable art of cats as quiet spirit guides for rest, comfort, protection and new beginnings. Each piece comes with its own legend, an intention card and a 7-day ritual page.
text.c1Text: A cat has nine lives. In our legend, each life it gives away becomes a guardian with one quiet job. Tap a card to read its legend.
text.c2Text: Cats for the small rituals of everyday life: clearing your aura, making a wish on the full moon, finding the courage to start.

facts.l: the range of a cat's purr

story: I'm Mira. My first cat, Fıstık (“pistachio” in Turkish), came into my life when I was five. That little cat taught me one of the most important things I know: a cat knows how you feel before you say a word.

Twenty-five years have passed, and cats have never left my life. Today I care for the street cats in my neighborhood and the cats at our local shelter. I carry food, fill water bowls, look after the ones who fall sick, and slowly earn the trust of the shy ones.

On the days I am sad, they sit quietly beside me. On the days I am anxious, they give me a slow blink, as if to say “calm down.” I grew up in Istanbul, a city where cats belong to everyone, and I believe they carry a spiritual energy that comes to keep us company.
I set my own intention into every piece. They are not miracles. They are reminders to breathe, to slow down, and to remember you are not alone.
text.signature: With purrs, Mira & the Nine Lives

notes.p: These pieces are for reflection, comfort and inspiration. They are not a medical product, do not replace professional care, and no specific result is promised.
Your files are ready right after purchase. Print at home, at a local print shop, or set the wallpaper on your phone.
Files are for personal use only and not for resale. Colors may vary slightly by screen and printer.

products.label: Guardian 1
products.name: Moonlight Cat
products.legend: The first life a cat gives away becomes the Moonlight Cat. It keeps watch while you sleep, so your mind can finally put the day down. When you cannot rest, it curls up at the edge of your dreams and breathes slowly until you breathe with it.
products.title: Spiritual Cat Art, Sleeping Tabby on a Moonlit Cloud, Calming Rest Energy Print
products.alt: Sleeping Tabby on a Moonlit Cloud

products.label: Guardian 2
products.name: Healing Purr Cat
products.legend: The second life becomes the Healing Purr Cat. Its purr hums between 25 and 150 Hz, a sound people have always found comforting. When your heart is tired, it sits on your chest and purrs until the heaviness feels a little lighter.
products.title: Spiritual Tuxedo Cat Art, Soothing Heart Light and Purr Waves on Golden Clouds, Comfort Print
products.alt: Soothing Heart Light and Purr Waves on Golden Clouds

products.label: Guardian 3
products.name: Nazar Guardian
products.legend: The third life becomes the Nazar Guardian. It sits at the edge of your home like a cat at the door, with blue nazar lights circling it like watchful eyes. What is not meant for you passes by. What is yours may stay.
products.title: Spiritual Black Cat Art, Evil Eye Protection Circle in a Galaxy, Arcane Energy Print
products.alt: Evil Eye Protection Circle in a Galaxy

products.label: Guardian 4
products.name: Golden Cat
products.legend: The fourth life becomes the Golden Cat. It walks the river of light where every good thing begins, and wherever its paws touch, gold ripples outward. It reminds you that receiving is a skill, and you are allowed to learn it.
products.title: Spiritual Cat Art, Orange Tabby Walking on Golden Light Ripples, Abundance Frequency Print
products.alt: Orange Tabby Walking on Golden Light Ripples

products.label: Guardian 5
products.name: Lucky Cat
products.legend: The fifth life becomes the Lucky Cat. Where it steps, a stone of light appears, so the road is never fully visible until you begin to walk. It does not carry luck to you. It walks beside you as you go and find it.
products.title: Spiritual Cat Art, Grey Tabby Walking Toward a Door of Light, Good Luck Print
products.alt: Grey Tabby Walking Toward a Door of Light

products.label: Guardian 6
products.name: Rose Cat
products.legend: The sixth life becomes the Rose Cat. It reaches for love the way a cat reaches for sunlight, without asking whether it deserves it. It teaches you that the first heart to open is your own.
products.title: Spiritual White Cat Art, Gazing Up at a Rose Heart Nebula, Self Love Energy Print
products.alt: Gazing Up at a Rose Heart Nebula

products.label: Guardian 7
products.name: Karma Cat
products.legend: The seventh life becomes the Karma Cat. It never carries old threads for long. It shakes them loose, one by one, and lets the stars take them. It reminds you that letting go is not losing. It is making room.
products.title: Spiritual Cat Art, Tortoiseshell Releasing Violet Threads into the Stars, Karma Cleansing Print
products.alt: Tortoiseshell Releasing Violet Threads into the Stars

products.label: Guardian 8
products.name: Third Eye Cat
products.legend: The eighth life becomes the Third Eye Cat. It is the cat that stares at an empty corner and knows something is there. It sees what is quiet, not what is loud. It reminds you that your first feeling is often your truest one.
products.title: Spiritual Siamese Cat Art, Third Eye Light and Indigo Galaxy Rings, Intuition Print
products.alt: Third Eye Light and Indigo Galaxy Rings

products.label: Guardian 9
products.name: Phoenix Cat
products.legend: The ninth and last life becomes the Phoenix Cat. It is born from the moment a cat lands on its feet after a fall. It rises out of the embers of what has ended, and reminds you that you can begin again as many times as you need.
products.title: Spiritual Cat Art, Ginger Tabby Leaping from Golden Embers at Dawn, Phoenix Rebirth Print
products.alt: Ginger Tabby Leaping from Golden Embers at Dawn

products.label: Spirit Companion
products.name: Aura Cat
products.legend: Cats spend hours grooming, as if they know that energy, like fur, needs care. The Aura Cat shakes off the dust of crowded days and heavy rooms, and what is left is its own clean light. It reminds you that you are allowed to come back to yourself.
products.title: Spiritual Cat Art, Silver Tabby on a Starlit Lake, Rainbow Aura Cleanse Print
products.alt: Silver Tabby on a Starlit Lake

products.label: Spirit Companion
products.name: Amethyst Kitty
products.legend: Cats always find the one warm, quiet spot in a room. The Crystal Cat found the quietest place of all, at the heart of an amethyst. It rests there with its eyes open, teaching you that calm is not sleep. It is clear, steady attention.
products.title: Spiritual Cat Art, Cream Kitty Resting on Glowing Amethyst Crystals, Crystal Energy Print
products.alt: Cream Kitty Resting on Glowing Amethyst Crystals

products.label: Spirit Companion
products.name: Full Moon Kitty
products.legend: Every cat has stood on its hind legs at least once, reaching for something just out of reach. The Full Moon Cat reaches for the moon itself. It does not wait for the wish to fall. It stretches, it reaches, and the moon leans a little closer.
products.title: Spiritual Cat Art, Tuxedo Kitty Reaching for the Full Moon, Manifestation Energy Print
products.alt: Tuxedo Kitty Reaching for the Full Moon

products.label: Spirit Companion
products.name: Starseed Cat
products.legend: Some cats stare at the night sky for a long time, as if remembering something. The Starseed Cat remembers where it came from. It walks the Milky Way home and leaves stardust where it steps, so that anyone who feels out of place can follow the light back.
products.title: Spiritual Cat Art, Russian Blue Walking a Golden Stardust Path, Starseed Galaxy Print
products.alt: Russian Blue Walking a Golden Stardust Path

products.label: Spirit Companion
products.name: Crystal Shield Cat
products.legend: A cat knows exactly where its space ends and where yours begins. The Shield Cat carries that knowing as a sphere of crystal light, so heavy moods and crowded rooms roll off and drift away. It reminds you that boundaries are not walls. They are a kind of care.
products.title: Spiritual Cat Art, Grey Tabby Inside a Crystal Light Sphere, Protection Shield Print
products.alt: Grey Tabby Inside a Crystal Light Sphere

products.label: Spirit Companion
products.name: Golden Joy Kitty
products.legend: Cats never forget how to play, even when they are old. The Joy Cat chases bubbles of light through the morning clouds, and every one it touches bursts into a tiny sun. It reminds you that lightness is not childish. It is a kind of strength.
products.title: Spiritual Cat Art, Orange and White Kitty Leaping for Bubbles of Light, Joy Energy Print
products.alt: Orange and White Kitty Leaping for Bubbles of Light

products.label: Spirit Companion
products.name: Sunrise Cat
products.legend: A small cat will face down a big dog without blinking. The Sunrise Cat climbs to the highest rock before dawn and greets the sun as an equal. It reminds you that courage is not the absence of fear. It is standing tall anyway.
products.title: Spiritual Cat Art, Ginger Tabby on a Mountain Peak at Sunrise, Courage Energy Print
products.alt: Ginger Tabby on a Mountain Peak at Sunrise
